description: This file defines the MetadataEnvelope class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the Crypto namespace. The class manages encryption metadata headers essential for cryptographic operations, including constants for header keys, methods to access constant values, inline validation for setting data, and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: MetadataEnvelope
classes.description: A class that stores and manages encryption metadata headers used during cryptographic operations, supporting array access, iteration, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getConstantValues
methods.description: Returns an array of all constant header key names used in encryption metadata.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a header value after validating the header key against predefined constants; throws exception if validation fails.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the metadata to a JSON-compatible structure, typically an associative array.
